model.benchmark: Same asset returns and dates; single long buy-and-hold or daily equal-weight long basket.
model.feeTiming: After gross close return, on pre-fee drift-adjusted risky turnover.
model.feesPaid: Actual synthetic charges in initial-capital units, distinct from counterfactual terminal wealth drag.
model.limitations: Synthetic exposure costs, not broker notional; no fee feedback into targets/drift, financing, borrow, funding, taxes or market impact.
model.turnover: One-way risky exposure; includes initial entry and target drift; no terminal liquidation.

storage.fullHistory: Referenced shared v2 evidence objects; not copied.
storage.publication: Replace current costs subtree; do not accumulate historical run charts.
